plain: A business owned and run jointly by partners.

webster.text: Joint concern in business; a state of having a joint share in a common stock, or a joint interest and concern in business, particularly in trade and manufactures.

example.quote: The honorable member from Anson has likened this business to a copartnership, comparing small things to great.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. DAVIE, July 31, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
